indicator_name: Retail Trade Physical Volume Index, monthly
description: Индекс физического объёма розничной торговли, помесячно
methodology: Index, same month of the previous year = 100 -- retail volume in REAL terms, the consumption-side companion to RETAIL_TRADE_MONTHLY, which is in current prices. Monthly replacement for the annual RETAIL_TRADE_VOLUME_INDEX. The source row also publishes month-on-month and year-to-date comparisons; this is the year-on-year monthly one. History from 2016-01 out of Taldau index 702041 (unrounded there; the bulletin's one-decimal value wins where both exist).
